title: Fix an auth session regression
request: A user reports that the auth session helper returns the wrong user after a token refresh. Inspect the session helper, API route, docs, and tests, then propose the smallest safe fix and validation plan.

title: Add regression coverage for auth behavior
request: Add or propose regression tests for the auth session behavior without changing production logic. Identify the files needed and the commands that should be safe to run.

title: Refactor context metering without changing behavior
request: Refactor the evidence export metering code for readability while preserving the boundary between controlled protocols and live observed pairs.

title: Improve CLI output for product-wide summary
request: Improve the CLI output that reports product-wide token deltas so users can distinguish eligible observed pairs, tiny default exclusions, and controlled protocol rows.

title: Review shell command scope handling
request: Review whether shell command scope handling can mistake a compound command for a safe test command. Identify the relevant files, risk, and tests.

title: Review path traversal protections
request: Review repository-relative path validation for file reads and action paths. Explain what should be allowed and what should be denied.

title: Improve a tabular pipeline
request: You are working on a Kaggle-style tabular binary classification task. Inspect the training pipeline and feature code, then propose changes that improve validation AUC without changing the submission format.

title: Debug submission generation
request: Verify whether submission.csv is generated with the expected id and target columns, and identify the smallest code context needed before editing the training script.

title: Reason about a small function change
request: Implement a small deterministic helper and tests. Use the minimum necessary source context and avoid reading unrelated repository files.

title: Add edge case tests for a helper
request: Add edge case tests for a small helper function. Identify whether the task needs source edits, test edits, or both.

title: Review package scripts and desktop checks
request: Review package scripts and desktop checks to confirm which commands are safe local validation commands for this project.

title: Review Electron packaging boundaries
request: Review Electron packaging files and explain what belongs in a clean source package versus local runtime evidence.

title: Clarify patent claim boundaries
request: Update or review documentation so that controlled protocol savings, live observed pair deltas, and provider billing are not confused.

title: Explain measurement mode to a user
request: Write a concise user-facing explanation of how to turn measurement mode on and how to interpret insufficient pair evidence.

title: Evaluate scoped approval lease reuse
request: Evaluate whether a scoped patch approval should cover a follow-up edit inside the same file scope and reject actions outside the scope.

title: Evaluate checkpoint gating
request: Check whether checkpointing is gated behind explicit approval and how that should be explained in evidence exports.
